Now viewing one reference from each top candidate:
This Stewart's Disease reference matches well - same pale tan streaks running lengthwise. Now checking Goss's Wilt:
Goss's Wilt looks very different (large dark wavy lesions). Now checking Northern Leaf Blight:

Northern Leaf Blight shows discrete cigar-shaped lesions, not full-length streaks. The test image is clearly different from both Goss's Wilt and NLB. Viewing one more Stewart's Disease reference to confirm:

Both Stewart's Disease references match the test image very closely: pale, bleached tan streaks running the full length of the leaf parallel to veins. The test image has no freckles (ruling out Goss's Wilt), no discrete cigar shapes (ruling out NLB), and no pustules (ruling out rusts). The full-length bleached streaks are the hallmark of Stewart's Disease leaf blight phase.
